name: Sinicuichi
summary: A perennial shrub with small narrow leaves and yellow flowers growing up to ~1.5 meters. The drug is known under many different names. The drug been used for shamanic purposes by indigenous people in Central America and Mexico. The drug is reported to be mainly auditory based.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: The plant contains several alkaloids of the quinolizidine type, including vertine (also called cryogenine), lythrine and nesodine. How they produce its effects in people is not well understood.
pharmacology.zh: 這種植物含有多種喹嗪啶類生物鹼，包括vertine（又稱cryogenine）、lythrine與nesodine。這些成分如何在人體產生作用，目前仍不清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 这种植物含有多种喹嗪啶类生物碱，包括vertine（又称cryogenine）、lythrine与nesodine。这些成分如何在人体产生作用，目前仍不清楚。

uses.en: Indigenous people in Mexico and Central America have used a fermented drink made from its leaves in ceremonies, and it is also used in folk medicine. Some people use it recreationally for its mild, mostly auditory effects.
uses.zh: 墨西哥與中美洲的原住民會在儀式中飲用以其葉子發酵製成的飲品，它也用於民俗療法。也有人為了它溫和、以聽覺為主的效果而作娛樂性使用。
uses.zhHans: 墨西哥与中美洲的原住民会在仪式中饮用以其叶子发酵制成的饮品，它也用于民俗疗法。也有人为了它温和、以听觉为主的效果而作娱乐性使用。

sideEffects.en: Reports describe drowsiness, mild muscle relaxation, sounds seeming distant or distorted, and a yellow tint to vision. It has been little studied, so its risks in people are not well known.
sideEffects.zh: 使用報告提到嗜睡、輕微肌肉放鬆、聲音聽起來遙遠或扭曲，以及視覺帶有黃色。由於研究很少，它對人體的風險目前所知不多。
sideEffects.zhHans: 使用报告提到嗜睡、轻微肌肉放松、声音听起来遥远或扭曲，以及视觉带有黄色。由于研究很少，它对人体的风险目前所知不多。

fact.en: One of its common names, sun opener, is linked to the traditional way of preparing it: the wilted leaves are soaked in water and left in the sun to ferment. Users have long reported that it can give the world a yellow tint.
fact.zh: 它有一個俗名叫「太陽開啟者」，與傳統的製作方式有關：把萎凋的葉子泡在水裡，放在陽光下發酵。長久以來，使用者常描述它會讓眼前的世界帶上一層黃色。
fact.zhHans: 它有一个俗名叫「太阳打开者」，与传统的制作方式有关：把萎凋的叶子泡在水里，放在阳光下发酵。长久以来，用户常描述它会让眼前的世界带上一层黄色。
